title: Recognizer Research
summary: The preparatory rhythm increment and expanded architecture experiment design have passed independent technical reviews. Training is authorized but has not run; local fit, musical gains and novelty remain unestablished.

milestones.title: Audit and research design
milestones.detail: Eight areas reviewed; native Dereck review obtained; 36-step protocol approved after two corrections. Protocol approval is not empirical validation.

milestones.title: Frozen rhythm baseline
milestones.detail: Ten rhythm-only executions completed: four copied local development recordings and six synthetic controls. Four adapter tests pass. Original source/audio checksums are retained; the full app was not run.

milestones.title: Task-separated scoring harness
milestones.detail: Task-separated standard-library prototype: 18 tests pass, including exhaustive small event-match checks. The CLI was exercised on all ten actual baseline outputs. All-octave diagnostics differ from the historical restricted half/original/double score; continuity remains deferred.

milestones.title: Blinded reference and source eligibility
milestones.detail: Blinded manual, blank forms, disagreement/effort logs, structural validator and rights/overlap inventory are prepared. Five validator tests pass. No human annotation or listening packet is claimed.

milestones.title: Historical pulse-error diagnosis
milestones.detail: All 78 guitar and 115 drum retained predictions reaggregated. Nine missing-media exclusions remain explicit. Reference-informed correction is only an oracle diagnostic.

milestones.title: Independent validation of execution increment
milestones.detail: Independent scientific and frontend reviews approve this preparatory increment, not musical validity. Bounded independent adapter reproduction passed all four tests with writable temporary and Numba-cache directories, closing the earlier environment-only verification gap.

milestones.title: Retraining and architecture lane
milestones.evidence_type: Prospective experiment design and independent correction/closure review
milestones.detail: A 23-arm candidate matrix covers unchanged/simple baselines, a lightweight trained head, limited fine-tuning and conditional architecture controls. Six review corrections are applied; fresh independent review approves design coherence only. Fresh resource, rights, label and split preflight is still required before fitting. No training has run.

milestones.title: Independent musical confirmation
milestones.detail: The local inventory establishes zero presently eligible new composition-independent, rights-evidenced confirmation sources; shortfall: twelve for the planned feasibility batch. Two independent musical annotators are also not yet recruited.

milestones.title: Training execution preflight
milestones.detail: Measure resource fit and verify rights, labels, source-group splits and local assets before selecting a bounded exploratory fit. Retain inherited 512 MiB cumulative new files and 30 GiB free disk until an explicit separately scoped preflight changes the envelope. No automatic cache deletion.

findings.title: Pulse-level mistakes dominate a large share of retained drum error
findings.detail: Using the predeclared descriptive 4% reference-relative half/double-nearness rule, 22 of 115 drum records account for 64.49% of summed exact relative error. The corresponding guitar values are 3 of 78 and 14.32%. This is retained-development arithmetic, not a new model gain or proof of perceptual correctness.
findings.confidence: HIGH for the retained arithmetic; generalization unestablished
findings.source: diagnosis/RESULTS.md and diagnosis.json, 2026-10-24; internal development evidence

findings.title: The frozen baseline reproduces a numerical half-rate case
findings.detail: On a synthetic 180-pulse-per-minute control, the unchanged estimator returns 89.1 BPM. Silence, DC and the tested sustained tone return unavailable BPM. These controls establish numerical behavior only, not musical accuracy.
findings.confidence: HIGH for this pinned execution only

findings.title: Reference availability, not file availability, is the immediate bottleneck
findings.detail: The scoped local inventory found 1,241 media files and 746 existing benchmark audio memberships. Repeated/inspected material, isolated notes, uncertain composition identity and rights/overlap gaps mean zero sources are yet demonstrated eligible for new independent confirmation. This does not mean every local recording is unusable.
findings.confidence: HIGH for scoped counts and documented eligibility status; broader availability unknown

findings.title: A close 2026 architecture baseline changes the novelty boundary
findings.detail: Explore This! already learns a tatum grid and joint beat/downbeat metrical interpretations. Joint pulse/grid modeling alone is therefore not a sufficient novelty claim. Its reported limitations motivate candidates, but no local performance claim is replicated. The primary PDF and original reproduction-code commit were inspected.
findings.evidence_type: Primary academic paper, official conference page and released source
findings.confidence: HIGH on verified existence/overlap; local transfer unverified
findings.source: Kihlborg, Holzapfel and Schlüter, Explore This! (ISMIR 2026); https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14817 and https://github.com/CPJKU/explore_this

blockers: New independent musical confirmation still needs evidenced composition-independent, rights-cleared sources and two independent musical annotators. That blocks confirmation claims, not all exploratory training.
A concrete training-label, source-group split, checkpoint and resource-smoke protocol must be frozen before fitting. Existing session BPM labels do not supply perceptual beat/downbeat/meter truth.
No trained candidate gain, source-held-out confirmation, continuity validation or empirical paper is established. Paid compute and production changes are not authorized.
next_steps: Run a fresh tool-measured resource preflight and verify local asset availability, rights, label semantics and source-group splits against the independently reviewed design before selecting a bounded exploratory fit.
Freeze an admissible development training contract and run a bounded local trainability/resource smoke test; compare the smallest learned baseline before escalating.
In parallel, resolve the 12-source annotation-feasibility inventory and arrange two independent listening passes for later confirmation.

agents.responsibility: Blinded reference contract and source inventory

activity.title: Research execution authorized and dispatched
activity.action: Three disjoint native Codex agents; gpt-6.1-sol, model_reasoning_effort=medium.
activity.result: Running; no paid compute, source-app modification, audio/weight acquisition or submission.

activity.title: Frozen rhythm baseline and historical diagnosis completed
activity.action: Invocation summaries: run_baseline.py; unittest test_frozen_rhythm; reanalyse_rhythm.py and its self-tests. Existing local Python environments; no checkpoint/audio acquisition.
activity.result: Ten baseline/control cases finished; four adapter tests pass. Historical diagnosis reaggregates 193 inspected records. Independent execution/publication review still pending.

activity.title: Scoring and blinded-reference preparation reviewed
activity.action: Invocation summaries: metrics unittest (18 tests); annotation validator unittest (5 tests); independent scientific review; publisher unittest (6 tests); local and live headless-Chrome QA.
activity.result: Metric and reference contracts approved as preparatory infrastructure. Confirmation-source and human-annotation gates remain blocked; no musical performance gain or empirical submission claimed.

activity.title: Training and creative architectures authorized
activity.action: Recorded owner scope amendment; verified local PyTorch/MPS capability; retrieved primary architecture literature and pinned upstream implementation. Separate architecture-design worker requested as gpt-6.1-sol / medium.
activity.result: Training is allowed prospectively in the research workspace. No training has run. Explore This! is a close comparator; a novel or larger model is not automatically preferred.

activity.title: Architecture experiment design independently approved
activity.action: Applied six bounded review corrections and obtained fresh read-only closure over the exact current design hashes.
activity.result: Design coherence approved; training has not run. Resource fit, independent musical gains and novelty remain unestablished.

limits: Deployed checkpoints, not second-by-second monitoring. Refresh after a milestone deployment.
Synthetic controls test numerical behavior, not musical correctness.
Old diagnostic recordings are not fresh confirmation material.
CLPR remains the flagship. This is a proposed task-specific recognizer-qualification lane; rhythm/meter accuracy does not validate register or note-density constructs.
